image_description: A close-up photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), perched on green foliage. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is brown with distinct rows of cream-ringed black eyespots (ocelli). The body is fuzzy and brown, matching the wing coloration. Antennae are visible and appear clubbed. The background consists of out-of-focus green leaves and stems.
